extraction.name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
extraction.description: The ARC dataset consists of 7,787 natural, grade-school science questions authored for use on standardized tests, partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set. The release also includes the ARC Corpus, containing 14 million science-related sentences.
extraction.creator: Peter Clark; Isaac Cowhey; Oren Etzioni; Tushar Khot; Ashish Sabharwal; Carissa Schoenick; Oyvind Tafjord (Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence)
extraction.citeAs: Peter Clark, Isaac Cowhey, Oren Etzioni, Tushar Khot, Ashish Sabharwal, Carissa Schoenick, Oyvind Tafjord. Think you have Solved Question Answering? Try ARC, the AI2 Reasoning Challenge. arXiv:1803.05457v1 [cs.AI], 2018.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset of science questions was assembled through extensive search and investigation to gather questions authored for standardized tests. The supporting ARC Corpus was collected by running automated search queries on a major search engine using hand-written templates, collecting the top documents, and augmenting them with the AristoMini corpus.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Most examination boards release only limited practice tests to the public, restricting available data. Additionally, the dataset excludes non-publicly releasable questions from the Kaggle Allen AI Science Challenge, containing only the publicly releasable subset (about 60% of the Kaggle set).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of multiple-choice natural science questions from various standardized tests and examination boards (e.g., NY Regents, TIMSS, MCAS). The raw data for the supporting ARC Corpus includes web documents retrieved via search engines, the AristoMini corpus, dictionary definitions from Wiktionary, and articles from Simple Wikipedia.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The operational definition of a Challenge question only approximates the informal goal of it being a 'hard' question; the categorization of knowledge and reasoning types is necessarily approximate as it requires subjective judgement.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: encourage AI research in advanced question answering
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The ARC question set is partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set, where the Challenge Set contains only questions answered incorrectly by both a retrieval-based algorithm and a word co-occurrence algorithm.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The top several documents from each search were collected and de-duplicated, and then the content of these documents was stripped down to capture just the text in each document. The resulting text was then chunked into sentences.
